# Copilot instructions

Follow `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root. It is the operating contract for every agent working here.
Stage-by-stage procedures are in `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`, and the reference docs are in `docs/`.

Hard rules: zero cost, no AI images/video, every fact sourced in `facts.json`, stop at every approval
gate, never edit files listed in a video's `LOCK.json`, never commit or print secrets (the repo is public).
